digest.component_or_area: Jira dispatch / retry budget / operation outcome
propositions: One Jira summary postcondition write must complete within a single provider-neutral retry budget of at most three physical invocations and 15 seconds cumulative sleep.

Cloud ACLI and DC SDK summary-write routes must both use the same operation/outcome contract (logical id, desired state, invocation count, disposition, replay safety, retry_not_before, and bounded redacted diagnostics).
DC summary write must execute exactly GET-PUT-GET with no hidden retries; failure ends the invocation and successful read-back is authoritative.
Cloud recovery must use a single primary-store REST get_issue_by_rest call with one attempt and no sleep; DC recovery uses one GET observation with no sleep.

Desired summary observed after timeout means recovered success; failed or inconclusive observation returns non-replaying commit_unknown; over-budget provider delay returns retry_not_before without sleeping.

Every terminal/exhausted outcome must emit exactly one redacted completion log containing logical id, disposition, invocation/request counts, cleanup status, retry_not_before, and one message capped at 512 Unicode code points; the whole log is at most 1,024 code points.
